findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：2025年2月 Uber 在加州州法院提告，指控 DoorDash 部分商業做法違反競爭法；部分轄區競爭主管機關曾詢問或調查其定價條款，個別轄區已有決定。
findings.excerpt: For example, in February 2025, Uber filed a lawsuit in California state court alleging that certain of our business practices are anticompetitive. In addition, competition authorities in some of the jurisdictions in which we operate have made queries regarding, or investigated, our pricing-related terms or other practices

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：加州 EDD 就薪資稅審計並於2023年1月發出不利評定，公司提出上訴並已提列應計；另有多個轄區的政府調查與詢問。
findings.excerpt: we are currently under audit by the Employment Development Department of the State of California (the "CA EDD") for payroll tax liabilities. In January 2023, the CA EDD issued a negative assessment in connection with such audit.
